reasoning_content: I'm noticing the `/auth/me` endpoint isn't defined as a file route, so it must be registered through the TanStack Start server's server functions. The smoke test is checking that the response includes a `user` object with a `name` property, and for the local-builder setup it expects that name to be 'Builder Mock User'.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "Builder Mock User" . --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.mjs' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; echo "==="; grep -rn "auth.me\|/me'" apps/sva-studio-react/src/server 2>/dev/null | head; ls apps/sva-studio-react/src/server 2>/dev/null | head -20
